settings.title: Where it all began...
settings.content:
A father and a son, a small amount of stock to our name and a dream too big to put into words.

In 2010, William Wood was born in the garage of William Wood's late mother, May Wood. We had one clear belief - the pieces you bring into your home should make it feel unforgettable.

We had one goal: To create exclusive, design-led pieces with an unwavering commitment to quality. All backed by a level of service that sets a new standard in homeware.

From 2010 to 2019, we faced countless challenges, and fought day in day out to keep William Wood alive.

Fast forward to 2020, William Wood was brought to life through innovative design, Instagram and our community, and sales tripled in one year.

We've now had the pleasure of welcoming over 700,000 customers, and without each and every one of you, we wouldn't be the William Wood you know and love today.

The story continues, in homes like yours.
